findings.evidence: The inductive declaration at lines 61–67 lists exactly `commutation`, `stabilization`, and `destabilization`; `rg` finds no cyclic-shift move or theorem relating cyclic row/column relabelings to `MovesTo`, while `GridDiagram` is a pair of permutations on labeled `Fin n` coordinates (`Diagram/Basic.lean:693`).
findings.fix: Add elementary cyclic-row and cyclic-column permutation constructors (with corresponding `lift` invariance hypotheses), or first prove that every such cyclic relabeling lies in the equivalence closure of the existing moves and expose that theorem.
findings.issue: `IsMove` has constructors only for commutation, stabilization, and destabilization; standard grid equivalence also identifies cyclic permutations of all rows or columns. Since `GridDiagram` uses labeled `Fin n` coordinates, those translations are not definitional equalities, and the resulting quotient can distinguish diagrams representing the same grid link.

summary: The quotient omits cyclic row and column permutations, so it does not present grid links by the standard grid-move equivalence claimed.
